source.answer:
确认：2026方案设为当前，其余5套保留为历史方案。新建商品时，主条码方案自动默认选择2026，后续新生成的货品条码按该规则生成。
已有商品、SKU和条码不批量修改、不重编。保留商品编辑中的“补充历史／兼容条码”入口，允许后续将旧条码补录到准确的颜色、版型、尺码规格，补录不替换主条码。
请分别落实“方案分类”“新建默认值”“实际生成规则”和“旧码补录保存”，不要只改分类就记为完成。

native.name: 2020年新方案
native.rule_description: 原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。2020颜色1位、尺码2位的最后补充优先于原表旧备注。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。

approvedInitializationWriteContract: Run only after first empty bootstrap admission and before BARCODE stage, in same source-bound controlled import transaction/actor/receipt/audit closure. No pre-seeding before existing empty admission.
Exact name/source-key/UUID/full-seven-field snapshot frozen after approval. First create only or byte-equivalent exact replay; any drift/missing or extra row rejects.

Do not broaden empty admission, seed generic test rows, change raw code/SKU/source identity/approved21 demotions, enable a barcode regeneration engine, or infer per-barcode validity from scheme length/status.
No source/MAIN/PUBLISH permission is conferred by approval of six descriptive rows. Later actual execution retains all existing gates.

businessRequirements.newProductDefault: Default main barcode scheme2026 for new products;do not overwrite existing product selection
businessRequirements.newBarcodeGeneration: Newly generated product barcodes follow actual2026 scheme;implementation must trace exact approved/frozen rule, no guessed code or source rewrite
businessRequirements.compatibleOldCode: Keep supplement historical/compatible barcode entry;bind exact real color/fit/size SKU and retain main barcode unchanged
businessRequirements.existingData: No bulk modification or re-encoding of existing product/SKU/barcode

scopeBoundary: Business direction approved. New fields/constraints/dependent write-contract changes beyond approved exact six-row initialization require accurate consolidated delta per existing user rule. No automatic new schema or generated code algorithm assumed approved.
